description: The call to make before buying a NEP-141 token: who controls it (keys, owner, pause), whether you can get back out — a USDC round trip through NEAR Intents at your trade size, loss measured — and whether a few accounts hold most of the circulating supply. Over 15% lost or no route is STOP or HOLD; HIGH concentration is HOLD. One verdict with the quotes. size is in USD (default 100).
name: near_pre_trade_gate
